basic_details.job_title: District Court Unnao Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 27 Junior Assistant, Class and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Court Unnao (Janpad Nyayalaya Unnao) is filling 27 vacant posts – 19 Junior Assistant, 7 Class IV and 1 Sweeper – by re-employing retired district court employees. The application in the prescribed format must be submitted at the Administrative Office of the District Court, Unnao by 17 November 2026, 5:00 PM; applications received after this time will not be considered. The Junior Assistant posts are for retired Class III employees, and the Class IV and Sweeper posts for retired Class IV / Sweeper employees.

qualification.details: For each post, the pay is the last drawn pay the applicant received on the related post, from which the pension amount is deducted; the balance is paid as honorarium. No criminal or civil case should be pending and registered against the applicant. The form asks for the educational qualification, but the notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification. | The notice does not prescribe an age limit for applying; the tenure ends on completion of 65 years of age at the latest (see Important Instructions). Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for each post.

selection_process: The notice states that the applicant's past record and ACR (Annual Confidential Report) will be the basis of appointment. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.
important_instructions: Tenure: 1 year from the date of joining, or until the post is filled by direct recruitment or promotion, or until the employee completes 65 years of age – whichever is earlier. The appointment will be purely temporary and may be terminated without any prior notice if service is not found satisfactory. Applications received after the prescribed time (5:00 PM on 17 November 2026) will not be considered. The notice is to be circulated among retired employees of the district court, pasted on the court notice board, and uploaded on the websites of District Court Unnao and the High Court. A copy has been sent to the District Information Officer, Unnao, for free publication in at least two daily newspapers.

content_sections.heading: About Unnao District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Chairman, Selection Committee / District Judge, Unnao, for the District Court (Janpad Nyayalaya) Unnao. The re-employment of retired employees is being done in compliance with the Hon'ble High Court Allahabad's C.L. No. 14/Admin. (D) Section dated 15.10.2022. Two separate notices were issued on 05.11.2026: one for retired Class III employees (Junior Assistant) and one for retired Class IV / Sweeper employees.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed format attached to the notice and submitted at the Administrative Office, District Court, Unnao by 17 November 2026, 5:00 PM. The notice does not print a full postal address with PIN code and does not mention sending the application by post or email. Use the prescribed application form attached to the notice ("Application for employment on a vacant post to be filled through re-employment of retired employees in District Court Unnao"). Write the name of the post applied for at the top of the form. Fill in the details asked: name, father's / husband's name, date of birth, date of retirement, last post held and the name of the district court from where you retired, photo identity card details (ID card / Aadhaar card / other valid ID), permanent address, temporary address, mobile number, email ID and educational qualification. Attach a copy of the last drawn pay and the pension order – the form says this is mandatory. Sign the undertaking printed on the form, with the date and place (Unnao). Submit the application at the Administrative Office, District Court, Unnao before 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For each post, the pay is the last drawn pay the applicant received on the related post, from which the pension amount is deducted; the balance is paid as honorarium. The notice does not print a fixed amount. The applicant should be physically and mentally fit. The applicant's character roll for the previous 5 years should be correct (clean). No criminal or civil case should be pending and registered against the applicant. The form asks for the educational qualification, but the notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification. The notice does not prescribe an age limit for applying; the tenure ends on completion of 65 years of age at the latest (see Important Instructions). Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copy of the last drawn pay (mandatory) Copy of the pension order (mandatory) Details of a photo identity card (ID card / Aadhaar card / other valid ID) filled in the form Signed undertaking printed on the application form The applicant is physically fit and capable of working on the post applied for in District Court Unnao. To the applicant's knowledge, no penalty or entry was given during service that would bar re-employment. No criminal proceedings are pending against the applicant. No criminal or civil case against or relating to the applicant is pending in District Court Unnao. All information is true; the applicant accepts full responsibility and any action if it is found false, and has read and accepts all application rules and conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Unnao District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 27 vacancies: 19 Junior Assistant, 07 Class IV and 01 Sweeper.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted at the Administrative Office of District Court Unnao by 17 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after this time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only retired district court employees can apply. Retired Class III employees may apply for Junior Assistant, and retired Class IV / Sweeper employees for the Class IV and Sweeper posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The pay is the last drawn pay on the related post minus the pension amount, paid as honorarium.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application form attached to the notice, attach copies of the last drawn pay and the pension order, sign the undertaking and submit it at the Administrative Office, District Court Unnao by 17 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The applicant's past record and ACR will be the basis of appointment.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary, for 1 year from joining or until the post is filled by direct recruitment or promotion or until age 65, whichever is earlier, and may end without notice if service is unsatisfactory.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: A copy of the last drawn pay and the pension order must be attached to the application; this is mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. Can an applicant with a pending court case apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice requires that no criminal or civil case be pending and registered against the applicant.
